title: Space Cat Mimi
author: a picture book
desc: 咪咪是一隻住在太空船上的貓，她在沒有重力的地方睡覺、吃飯、打掃。

intro: My book today is a picture book: 'Space Cat Mimi.' Mimi lives in a spaceship!
我今天的書是一本繪本：《太空貓咪咪》。咪咪住在太空船上！

q: Mimi's bedroom is very small. She sleeps in a bag on the wall! Is your bedroom big or small?
咪咪的臥室很小。她睡在牆上的睡袋裡！你的房間大還是小？
o: cozy = 舒適溫馨的。but 連接兩個相反的感覺。
Small and cozy is the best, like Mimi's room.
小又溫馨最好了，就像咪咪的房間。
It's big. I have a big bed.
先回答，再補一句細節，對話會更自然。
A big bed! Mimi would want to sleep on it.
大床！咪咪會想睡在上面。
I share a room with my sister.
我和我的姊妹共用一間房。
share = 共用。sister 可以是姊姊或妹妹。
Sharing is nice. You can talk before sleep.
共用很好。睡前可以聊天。

q: There is no gravity, so things float. What would float in your room?
沒有重力，所以東西會飄起來。你房間裡什麼會飄起來？
o: A flying pillow! Pillow fights in space, ha!
飛起來的枕頭！太空枕頭大戰，哈！
all my + 名詞 = 我所有的…。
Books everywhere! Mimi uses a net to catch them.
到處都是書！咪咪用網子接住它們。
我的手機。我會把它弄丟。
I'd = I would，表示假設的情況。
Put it in your pocket! Mimi's jacket has many pockets.
放進口袋！咪咪的夾克有很多口袋。

q: Mimi looks out the window and sees Earth. What can you see from your window?
咪咪看出窗外，看見地球。你從窗戶能看到什麼？
o: City view! At night the lights look like stars.
城市景色！晚上燈光看起來像星星。
Ha! Maybe put a plant by the window.
哈！也許在窗邊放盆植物。

q: Mimi cleans the spaceship every day with a small robot. Who cleans your home?
咪咪每天和小機器人一起打掃太空船。你家誰打掃？
o: I do. 是「是我」的簡短回答。
Good job! A clean floor feels great.
很棒！地板乾淨感覺很好。
Teamwork! Like Mimi and her robot.
團隊合作！就像咪咪和她的機器人。
robot vacuum = 掃地機器人。vacuum = 吸塵器。
Me too! Then I can read more books.
我也是！那我就可以看更多書了。

end: Thanks for visiting Mimi's home! Next time, space food!
謝謝你來咪咪家玩！下次聊太空食物！

intro: Page ten is all about space food. Mimi eats from a tube!
第十頁都在講太空食物。咪咪用管子吃東西！

q: Space food comes in small packs. Would you like to try it?
太空食物裝在小包裝裡。你想試試看嗎？
o: sounds + 形容詞 = 聽起來…。
I think so too. Astronauts even eat ice cream!
我也這麼想。太空人甚至會吃冰淇淋！
Me too. Hot soup is the best.
tasty = 美味的。反問也是很好的回答。
Mimi says it's okay, but she misses fish!
咪咪說還可以，但她很想念魚！

q: Mimi is a cat, so she loves fish. What is your favorite food?
咪咪是貓，所以她愛吃魚。你最喜歡的食物是什麼？
o: Oh, famous Taiwanese food! I want to try it.
喔，有名的台灣食物！我想試試。
You and Mimi can be friends!
Cheese pizza is my favorite too! Chicken pizza is good, too.
起司披薩也是我最愛！雞肉披薩也不錯。

q: Bread makes crumbs, and crumbs float in space! So Mimi eats tortillas. Do you know tortillas?
麵包會掉屑，碎屑會在太空中飄！所以咪咪吃墨西哥餅皮。你知道墨西哥餅皮嗎？
o: Right! You can put meat and vegetables inside.
對！可以把肉和蔬菜包在裡面。
聽不懂就直接問，外國人很習慣這樣。
It's a soft, flat bread from Mexico.
是一種來自墨西哥、軟軟扁扁的餅。
用自己熟悉的東西來比較，是很好的聊天技巧。
A little, yes! Both are thin and round.
有一點像！兩個都是薄薄圓圓的。

q: Mimi drinks water from a bag with a straw. How much water do you drink every day?
咪咪用吸管從袋子裡喝水。你每天喝多少水？
o: Try a big cup on your desk. It helps!
在桌上放個大杯子試試。很有用！
I drink more tea than water.
more A than B = A 比 B 多。
A tea lover! In Taiwan, bubble tea, right?
愛喝茶！在台灣是珍珠奶茶吧？

end: Mimi says goodbye! Meow! See you next time.
